title: Account moving to a new device
summary: On a phone that is already signed in: a full alert when someone started a recovery of this account, with a cancel button while the delay runs. Also a notice after the account signed in on a new device with the synced token, and after an Apple or Google account was linked or unlinked (ADR 0096).

id.description: The link event id. Stable key.

notice.description: The newest recovery that the person has not dismissed: a waiting one, or a completed token recovery.

linkNotice.description: The newest link event from GET /v1/me/account link_events that the person has not dismissed and that is newer than this phone's first check. Shown when no recovery notice is.

check.effect: On launch, on foreground, and at once on a recovery push (notification-service kinds recoveryStarted and recoveryCompleted: when it arrives with the app open, and on its tap): reads GET /v1/me/account and sets notice.

cancel.effect: For a waiting recovery: asks for a biometric check (or the device PIN), then sends the cancel. Shows bipe_recovery_alert_cancelled.

keep.effect: It was me: dismisses the notice (recovery or link) on this phone. A recovery goes on.

notes: The alert covers the screen while a recovery waits. It is not a banner the person can miss.

Body per method and purpose: email, guardian, cpf for access; pinReset uses bipe_recovery_alert_pin_reset; a completed token recovery uses bipe_recovery_alert_token and has no cancel. Each takes readyAt formatted by the system.
Dismissed ids stay on this phone only.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.account and cancelRecovery, BipeAccountStatus, BipeRecovery (iOS); BipeRecoveryAlerts, BipeDeviceAccount.dismissedRecoveries and dismissRecovery (Android).

apple and google recoveries use bipe_recovery_linked_apple_alert and bipe_recovery_linked_google_alert and can be cancelled. A link notice uses bipe_linked_*_alert or bipe_unlinked_*_alert, has no cancel, and keep closes it. A link made on this phone is dismissed here when it is made.
